verdict.rationale: Paychex Flex has a documented REST API with OAuth 2.0. Its documented use cases cover workers, employee data maintenance, complex check creation, recurring deductions, state taxes and webhooks, but nothing claims or shows parity with the UI. Many UI capabilities, such as running payroll, approving time off, dashboards and reporting, and AI compliance tools, have no API equivalent in the evidence, and probes found no published OpenAPI spec to verify coverage. Missing for 10: any documented claim or evidence of API/UI parity, API coverage of payroll runs, time-off approvals, reporting, benefits and HR tools, a machine-readable spec showing full surface area, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
